sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select kind,client as who,detail from v_attention order by kind,client

sections.title: Waiting to be allocated
sections.sql: select client,days_waiting,urgency,concern,preferred_site,preferred_discipline from v_intake order by urgency desc,days_waiting desc

sections.title: Next seven days
sections.sql: select starts_at,practitioner,client,site,room,service,status from v_diary where starts_at>=now() and starts_at<now()+interval '7 days' order by starts_at

sections.title: Caseload
sections.sql: select practitioner,discipline,takes_new,weekly_capacity,booked_next_7,free_next_7,active_clients from v_caseload order by free_next_7 desc

sections.title: CPD this registration year
sections.sql: select practitioner,hours,peer_hours,target,peer_target,year_end from v_cpd order by practitioner

sections.title: Rooms next seven days
sections.sql: select site,room,bookings_next_7,hours_next_7 from v_rooms order by site,room

sections.title: Owed to practitioners
sections.sql: select practitioner,currency,receipts,received_cents,owed_cents,oldest_receipt from v_payouts_due order by practitioner

sections.title: Owed to the practice
sections.sql: select name,client,payer,currency,balance_cents,days_overdue from v_debtors where balance_cents>0 order by days_overdue desc
